info.name: Sariee Cart Bug Report (aurealis)
info.description:
For aurealis.sariee.shop.

TWO server-side cart bugs on api.sariee.com. Both surface as database errors from your backend (MySQL), so they look like they need a migration / missing table on the Sariee side. The storefront request format is correct (proven earlier: register/login/checkout all work).

BUG 1 — Updating the quantity of an item already in the cart.
  POST /api/frontend/cart/add-update with a barcode that is ALREADY in the cart returns HTTP 500:
    {"status":false,"internal_code":500,"code":500,"message":"Something Went Wrong","data":null}
  The FIRST add of a barcode works (200). Only changing the quantity of an existing line fails.

BUG 2 — Reading a cart that has items.
  POST /api/frontend/cart/init on a NON-EMPTY cart returns HTTP 406 with a raw SQL error, e.g.:
    SQLSTATE[42S02]: Base table or view not found: 1146 Table 'sariee.cart_bundle_selections' doesn't exist
      (select * from `cart_bundle_selections` where `cart_item_id` in (...) and `deleted_at` is null)
    ...and sometimes: SQLSTATE[42S22]: Column not found: 1054 Unknown column 'cart...'.
  init on an EMPTY cart works (200).

HOW TO USE: Run the requests top to bottom (or 'Run collection'). Step C1 auto-fills the barcode id and mints a FRESH cart token for the run. Screenshot the responses of C4 (BUG 1) and C5 (BUG 2).

Net effect: a cart works for the first add of each product, but cannot have item quantities changed and cannot be re-read once it has items — because the backend queries a `cart_bundle_selections` table/column that doesn't exist.
